decision_conditions:
S73 - CONSENT LIMITED TO THAT OF ORIGINAL PERMISSION:  The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than the expiration of 24 June 2028.

REASON: To ensure the commencement timescale for the development is not extended beyond that of the original planning permission granted on 24 June 2025 [LBI Ref: P2025/1232/FUL]. Furthermore, to comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
description: Section 73 Application seeking the variation of Condition 2 (Approved Drawings and Documents) and removal of Condition 6 (Restriction on Use of Flat Roof as Amenity Space) of Planning Permission Ref: P2025/1232/FUL, dated 24/06/2025.  The amendments sought are for the repositioning of the reinstated rear first floor balustrade by approximately 450mm forward and change of existing timber balustrade material with painted metal railings
